_readme: THE KIND x BIOME DENSITY TABLE: how much of the occupancy cap each asset
class may use, per biome, 0.0..1.0 (exported as per-mille; the engine
REFUSES values above 1.0 -- the table may only thin, never boost, because
a placement policy may only veto sites). 1.0 everywhere reproduces the
pre-table world exactly. Missing kinds or biomes read as 1.0.
This is the knob the 2026-08-18 census showed was missing: biome weights
saturate the occupancy cap, so every rich biome carried the same density
(savanna == temperate forest) and the single per-layer density did all
the work everywhere. This table scales the KEEP test per kind per biome,
linearly, after the species pick -- see docs/placement-spec-schema.md.
Any edit here changes the manifest: worldgen change, kWorldGenVersion
bump, goldens re-blessed, per the v24 contract.
_seeding: First real values, 2026-08-18, seeded from real-world cover fractions
against the same-day census (docs/biome-placement-survey.md) as the
'before'; the owner tunes from here. The reasoning per row:
savanna:   census 143 trees/ha reads as closed woodland; real savanna
runs 5-30/ha -> tree 0.15. Scrub patchy -> bush 0.4.
Grass-rich stays full.
grassland: census ~200 trees/ha at a GRASSLAND site -> tree 0.08;
steppe shrubs sparse -> bush 0.3; meadow flowers stay full.
desert:    census 65 canopy/ha EXCEEDED the rainforest's and 1,640
bush/ha read as sagebrush steppe -> tree 0.25, bush 0.35,
grass 0.15, flower 0.1 (bloom-event rarity).
temperate_forest: the reference forest, tree stays 1.0; understory
thinned a notch (bush 0.8) and floor cover to forest-floor
levels (grass/flower 0.7) after the owner's walkability
retunes of the same day.
rainforest: NOT thinned anywhere -- the census shows it starved (56
canopy/ha, fewer than the desert); that is a weight-roster
gap this table cannot fix (it can only thin).
taiga:     tree-rich is correct and stays 1.0; boreal floor is moss
and lichen more than flowers -> flower 0.3, bush 0.7.
tundra_alpine: dwarf-shrub heath is patchy -> bush 0.6, flower 0.5;
trees are already zeroed by the treeline gate (1.0 is
deliberate: the gate owns that verdict, not this table).
beach:     sparse coastal woody cover -> tree 0.5, bush 0.6; wrack and
strand lines keep reeds/rocks full.
bare_rock: crevice plants only -> bush/grass/flower 0.3.
ocean:     untouched; underwater tuning is not this pass.
rock:      1.0 EVERYWHERE on land -- the census found rocks NEAR-ABSENT
inland (2-22/ha vs 477 on the beach) and this table cannot
boost; making inland rocks visible is a biome-weight edit
(survey finding 3), deliberately left to that pass.
